properties.statement: A broker-owned provider mutation cannot execute through an admitted Overcenter effect path unless execution authority and exact claimed revision are current, a durable effect reservation has succeeded, and no prior unresolved effect exists for that run.
external_assumptions: Node.js runtime preserves JavaScript/TypeScript execution semantics used by the trusted slice.
node:crypto SHA-256 and randomUUID behave as specified.
node:sqlite provides the documented transaction, WAL, and synchronous=FULL semantics.
The operating system and filesystem correctly implement the durability guarantees requested by SQLite.

properties.statement: Overcenter cannot derive DONE for a run unless an admitted receipt and exact postcondition observation justify it, and replay cannot reinterpret unresolved or mismatched mutation evidence as success.
external_assumptions: Node.js runtime preserves JavaScript/TypeScript execution semantics used by the trusted slice.
Provider observations supplied to the verifier obey the provider-profile assumptions documented separately.
node:sqlite and the operating system preserve committed authority history according to the requested durability mode.

For GitHub-backed observations, node:child_process launches the intended system curl executable and curl faithfully returns the authenticated HTTPS response bytes and status metadata consumed by the verifier.

properties.statement: For the admitted GitHub commit-status mutation profile, repository identity, transport dispatch certainty, authoritative status observation, and exact provider coordinates are interpreted correctly.
external_assumptions: GitHub repository IDs and commit-status coordinates have the documented API meaning.
GitHub HTTPS responses correspond to the authenticated api.github.com endpoint reached by the transport.
TLS, DNS, sockets, and Node.js HTTPS correctly distinguish failure before secureConnect from failures after secureConnect.
The pinned GitHub API/OpenAPI contract accurately describes the response fields consumed by the verifier.
node:child_process launches the intended system curl executable, and curl faithfully returns the authenticated GitHub HTTPS response bytes and status metadata consumed by certified reads.
excluded: worker credentials when they are not broker credentials

compositions.statement: For the admitted GitHub commit-status path, an external mutation crosses the provider boundary only under current exact authority and durable reservation, and DONE is derived only from exact authoritative GitHub observation and valid settlement evidence.
